pricing.managedBody: Self-serve AI phone tools hand you a dashboard and leave the work to you. Calvo is run for you. Every item below is included in every plan, not sold as an add-on or billed as professional services.

managedItems.title: We build and configure the agent
managedItems.body: You do not write prompts, record greetings, or map call flows. We take your services, hours, pricing logic, and escalation rules and turn them into a working agent.

managedItems.title: We own the CRM integration
managedItems.body: Calls, outcomes, and caller details sync to your CRM in real time. We set the integration up and we keep it working when your CRM or your process changes.

managedItems.title: We keep tuning it after launch
managedItems.body: Weekly optimization against your real call outcomes, not a one-time setup you are then left to maintain yourself.

managedItems.title: Telephony, hosting, and reporting are ours to run
managedItems.body: Numbers, call handling, transcripts, and the dashboard are all part of the service. There is no separate infrastructure bill and no per-seat licence.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

meta.title: Privacy Policy — Calvo
meta.description: How Calvo collects, uses, stores, and shares information, including call recordings and transcripts handled by our AI calling agents.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what Calvo collects, why we collect it, and what we do with it. It covers our website and the AI calling agents we build and operate for our clients.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Calvo builds and operates custom-trained AI voice agents that answer, qualify, and route inbound calls for businesses. Calvo was formerly known as Digivixo.

For information collected through our own website and sales process, Calvo is the data controller. For call data processed on behalf of a client whose phone line we answer, Calvo acts as a processor and that client is the controller.

sections.heading: Information you give us
body: When you book a demo or email us, we collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, and whatever else you choose to include in your message.
When you become a client, we collect the operational details needed to build your agent: your services, hours, pricing logic, escalation rules, and the questions your callers typically ask.

sections.heading: Information collected automatically
body: Our website records standard technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages visited, and referring page. We use this to keep the site working and to understand which pages are useful.
We do not run advertising trackers or sell website analytics data.

sections.heading: Call recordings and transcripts
body: When a Calvo agent answers a call, we process the audio of that call in order to understand the caller and respond. Depending on the client's configuration, we may store the recording, a transcript, and structured metadata such as call time, duration, outcome, and whether the call was escalated to a person.
This data belongs to the client whose line the agent answers. We process it only to deliver and support the service, and to improve the accuracy of that client's own agent.

Recording and transcription are subject to the call-recording laws that apply where the caller and the business are located. Clients are responsible for ensuring appropriate notice and consent is given on their lines; we provide the configuration needed to do this.

sections.heading: How we use information
body: To build, train, operate, and support the agent a client has engaged us for.
To respond to enquiries and provide customer support.
To monitor reliability, diagnose faults, and prevent abuse or fraud.
To meet legal, tax, and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: What we do not do
body: We do not sell personal information.
We do not use one client's call data to train a shared or general-purpose model used for other clients.

sections.heading: Sharing and service providers
body: We share information with the service providers that make the product work — telephony, speech processing, language model inference, cloud hosting, and error monitoring. Each is bound by contract to process data only on our instructions.
A current list of subprocessors is available to clients on request.
We may also disclose information where we are legally required to, or to protect our rights or the safety of others.

sections.heading: Retention
body: Website enquiry data is kept for as long as needed to answer you and to keep a record of the relationship.
Call recordings, transcripts, and metadata are kept for the period agreed with each client, and are deleted or returned when the engagement ends. Clients can request earlier deletion at any time.

sections.heading: Security
body: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access is limited to the people who need it to run the service, and is logged.
No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your information, we will notify affected parties as required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your personal information, to object to or restrict processing, and to complain to a supervisory authority.
To exercise any of these, email us. If your data was processed on behalf of one of our clients, we will refer the request to that client and support them in answering it.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: This site uses only the cookies needed to serve and secure the pages. We do not set advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Children
body: Calvo is a business service and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We will update this page when our practices change, and will revise the date at the top. Material changes affecting clients will be communicated directly.

terms.title: Terms of service

meta.title: Terms of Service — Calvo
meta.description: The terms that govern use of the Calvo website and the AI calling agents Calvo builds and operates for its clients.

terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Calvo website and, where you engage us, the AI calling agents we build and operate for your business.

sections.heading: Agreement
body: By using this website or engaging Calvo, you agree to these terms. If you are agreeing on behalf of a company, you confirm you are authorised to do so.
Where you have signed a separate written agreement or order form with Calvo, that document governs and these terms fill any gaps.

sections.heading: The service
body: Calvo builds a voice agent configured around your business and operates it to answer your inbound calls. Scope, phone numbers, escalation rules, and reporting are agreed per engagement.
We may change how the service works over time. We will not materially reduce agreed functionality during a paid term without telling you.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the operational information you give us — services, hours, pricing, and escalation rules. The agent answers based on what you tell us.

You are responsible for holding the rights to any phone numbers you ask us to answer, and for complying with the telecommunications and call-recording laws that apply to your business and your callers, including any notice or consent your jurisdiction requires.
You will keep account credentials secure and tell us promptly about any unauthorised use.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: The service may not be used for unlawful, deceptive, or harassing activity; to impersonate a person or organisation you are not authorised to represent; to place unsolicited outbound calls in breach of applicable law; or to attempt to disrupt, reverse engineer, or gain unauthorised access to our systems.

sections.heading: Your data
body: Call recordings, transcripts, and the operational information you provide remain yours. You grant Calvo the licence needed to process them in order to deliver and support the service.
How that data is handled is described in the privacy policy.

sections.heading: Fees
body: Fees, billing frequency, and any usage-based charges are set out in your order form. Invoices are payable on the terms stated there.
Unless your agreement says otherwise, fees are exclusive of taxes.

sections.heading: Availability and AI output
body: We work to keep the service available and accurate, but no telephony or AI system is perfect. Calls may occasionally be misrouted, misunderstood, or missed, and agent responses may be wrong.
The service is not a substitute for a person where a call is urgent, medical, legal, or safety-critical. Escalation rules exist for exactly this reason and you should configure them accordingly.
Except as expressly stated, the service is provided without warranties of any kind.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential loss, or for lost profits, revenue, or goodwill.
Calvo's total liability arising out of the service is limited to the fees you paid to Calvo in the twelve months before the event giving rise to the claim.
Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

sections.heading: Termination
body: Either party may end an engagement on the notice set out in the order form. We may suspend the service immediately for non-payment or for a breach of the acceptable use section.
On termination we will stop answering your lines, return or delete your data as agreed, and hand back any numbers we hold on your behalf.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. If a change materially affects an active engagement, we will give notice before it takes effect.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: The governing law and the courts with jurisdiction are those stated in your order form.
